競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Fresh Stepの粗粒の猫砂を独占的に供給する長期契約
relations.text_en: Long-term exclusive supply agreement for Fresh Step coarse cat litter

source.label: Oil-Dri 10-K(2025年7月期)
source.quote: This long-term supply agreement with Clorox grants us the exclusive right to supply Clorox's requirements for Fresh Step coarse cat litter up to certain levels.

relations.text: Cloroxブランドの家電を複数年のライセンスで販売
relations.text_en: Sells Clorox-branded home appliances under a multiyear license

source.label: Hamilton Beach Brands 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: we participate in the premium market through multiyear licensing agreements to market and distribute CHI ® premium garment care products, Clorox TM home appliances

relations.text: 売上の26%を占める最大の顧客(2026年6月期)
relations.text_en: Its largest customer, 26% of net sales (FY ended June 2026)

source.label: Clorox 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Net sales to the Company's largest customer, Walmart Stores, Inc. and its affiliates, were 26%, 27% and 25% of consolidated net sales for the fiscal years ended June 30, 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively

relations.text: 手指消毒剤Purellのメーカーを2026年4月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired GOJO, maker of Purell, in April 2026

source.label: Clorox 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: In April 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of GOJO, expanding its product portfolio to include the Purell® brand and GOJO's health and hygiene solutions.

companies.name: プロクター・アンド・ギャンブル

relations.text: Gladの合弁が2026年1月に終了し、P&Gの持分を4.76億ドルで買い取った
relations.text_en: Bought out P&G's minority stake in the Glad joint venture for $476 million when it expired in January 2026

source.label: P&G 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Under the terms of the agreement, Clorox purchased the Company's minority interest in the venture at fair market value for $476 million.

relations.text: Church & Dwightが10-Kで、消費者製品の競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Church & Dwight names Clorox among competitors

source.label: Church & Dwight 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our competitors in the Consumer Domestic and Consumer International segments include, among others, Procter & Gamble Company ("P&G"), The Clorox Company

companies.name: オネスト・カンパニー

relations.text: Honestが10-Kで、スキンケアの競合として挙げる(Burt's Beesの親会社)
relations.text_en: Honest names Clorox (parent of Burt's Bees) among skin and personal care competitors

source.label: Honest Company 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Select competitors of our skin and personal care products include Kimberly-Clark Corporation (pending acquiror of Kenvue Inc.), The Clorox Company (parent company of Burt's Bees, Inc.)

companies.name: ヘイン・セレスティアル

relations.text: Hainが10-Kで、パーソナルケアの大手競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Hain lists Clorox first among large personal care competitors

source.label: Hain Celestial 10-K(2025年6月期)
source.quote: Large conventional personal care products companies with whom we compete include, but are not limited to, The Clorox Company

relations.text: TOMIが10-Kで、除菌分野の競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: TOMI names Clorox among disinfection competitors

source.label: TOMI Environmental Solutions 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The competition includes remediators and disinfection/decontamination companies such as Steris, Bioquell (Eco-lab) and Clorox
